records.text: And Blake Neff is the least believable person in the world. So glad to know that you guys think that having the State Department and the Department of War behind you is going to win the game, along with billionaires like Bill Ackman who are willing to promote your nonsense. But we see right through all of it. Top comments from the last episode before we went off air: Big Hair Do Care wrote, 'The way she drops these bombs and then goes on vacation.'
